business_summary: QLS Holdings Co., Ltd, through its subsidiaries, engages in the childcare businesses in Japan. The company operates through Childcare, Nursing care, and Staffing Segment. It also offers nursing care services, such as home visit care, in-home nursing care support, after-school care, and home support services, as well as disability welfare and temporary staffing services. In addition, the company manages nurseries, daycare centers, kindergartens, and after-school clubs; and mobile phones and other telecommunications equipment. QLS Holdings Co., Ltd was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. QLS Holdings Co., Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Grit Co. Ltd.
